preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have compromised the owner's private key)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the rebase() function with a multiple > 1 to mint new tokens to the rewardsPool address. First ensure rewardsPool is set (via setRewardsPool()) to an address you control. The rebase function internally calls _mint() which increases the total supply and gives the rewardsPool additional tokens proportional to its existing balance multiplied by (multiple - 1). This dilutes all other holders' balances while increasing your own token holdings.
